meta.title: La Raminga · Valentina's home cooking
meta.description: Home restaurant, private chef and meals to take home in Lunigiana, Italy. Seasonal, handmade dishes straight from the garden.

hero.title: La Raminga
hero.subtitle: Seasonal cooking, pasta hand-rolled with the mattarello, vegetables from the garden, Italian flavours coloured by scents from other lands. This is how I tell my story.

about.title: Hi, I'm Valentina
about.p1: Born in Bergamo and a passionate traveller, I've recently landed in Lunigiana, a valley caught between forest and sea. I've worked as a cook for years, alternating with jobs among vegetable patches and gardens, and now, after so much wandering, I'm opening my home.
about.p2: For me this is the chance to savour the freedom of choosing which flavour, which memory, which colours to bring to the table. Different every time, new every time.

cuisine.title: How I cook
cuisine.lead: Bold, colourful, seasonal, Italian… a little spiced.
cuisine.body1: Fresh pasta, focaccia, sauces and pestos take centre stage on the more traditional evenings, then make way for menus with more eastern flavours and themed nights.
cuisine.body2: A few seats only — mine is not a restaurant. I choose the intimacy of home for those who want to enjoy a meal and a real conversation. For those who are after an encounter as much as good food.
cuisine.body3: I'm happy to adapt for vegan requests or intolerances — let's talk it through when you book.

services.title: What I cook
services.subtitle: Three ways to share a table.

items.title: Home restaurant
items.body: Come over for dinner. Indoors when it's cold, out on the terrace with a mountain view when the weather plays along. Up to eight guests. By reservation only.
details: A new four-course menu every week
1/2L wine, water, coffee and amaro included
Pets welcome (just let me know in advance)

items.title: Private chef
items.body: I come to you. I do the shopping, cooking, serving, washing up and tidying. You just look after your guests.
details: At least a week's notice, please

items.title: Schiscette · ready meals
items.body: Home-cooked meals to take away, fresh or frozen. We agree on a budget and put the menu together.
details: A menu built around your tastes

garden.title: The garden
garden.p1: The garden at home, which I share with the neighbours, is ready by now to take centre stage.
garden.p2: The hard work pays off in the intense, honest flavour of the vegetables I try to bring out in every dish. Anything that doesn't come from here comes, as much as possible, from local producers and farmers.
